rationale: Author-of-record lens over commit 66be65a7 on bead/mindspec-ta30.10. (1) Plan §Bead 10 steps delivered in full: step 1 — idle.md and review.md both carry the R7 new-spec-for-frozen-contract guidance plus the literal `mindspec impl adopt <spec-id> --reason "<why>"` invocation, with cmd/mindspec/frozen_contract_guidance_test.go pinning it to the registered cobra tree; step 2 — merge-safety.md gains the gate-refusal-retry section scoped strictly to the gate-refusal class with POST-gate failures explicitly routed to spec 127's preserved-merge/forward-reconcile guidance ('Do not reach for --allow-doc-skew/--override-adr for a POST-gate failure'), and lifecycle-modes.md cross-links in both directions while touching only the trailing see-also prose (bead-4 agreement-table pins re-run green: go test ./internal/phase/ -run Agreement ok); step 3 — I re-ran `mindspec validate docs --diff ae45fd7a...` in the bead worktree myself: ZERO error legs, only the pre-existing out-of-scope missing-source-globs WARN, so the branch completes without --allow-doc-skew; step 4 (tally-carried) — the .gitignore OWNERSHIP claim landed in core with recorded rationale. (2) AC-12 vs GH #221's actual ask: I read the live issue; its two-part suggested fix (guidance that new implementation work including a frozen contract uses a new spec, PAIRED with a how-to-cleanly-reach-idle-after-external-merge note) is delivered verbatim-in-spirit in BOTH templates — each states the rule ('a frozen contract does not obviate an implementation spec') adjacent to the named exit (impl adopt with --reason, pointing at merge-safety.md), exactly the rule+exit pairing R7.2 requires. (3) The cobra pin is genuine, checked in both flip directions by reading the mechanics: an adopt rename or re-parenting makes findCommandByPath (verb_output_test.go:336, which t.Fatalf's on no match) fail AND trips the CommandPath() guard — red; a reason-flag rename makes Flags().Lookup("reason") return nil — t.Fatal, red; template drift with the command unchanged fails the strings.Contains against the DERIVED CommandPath()/flag-name substrings — red. The matching substring is derived from the live tree, never a second literal (the one hardcoded string is a locator/guard that only makes failure earlier, not weaker). Test re-run green. (4) OWNERSHIP disposition: bead 1's recorded override reason (bd show mindspec-ta30.1: 'the ownership claim is assigned to bead 10's sweep') deliberately left the domain open; core is the right call — core owns internal/phase/** (phaselock.go, the machinery whose lockfile path the debt-creating entry ignores) AND internal/state/** behind the file's other mindspec-runtime entries (session.json, current-spec.json); the one genuine alternative, workflow (owns internal/panel/**, the dispositions.lock entry's machinery), has a strictly weaker claim on the file. No overlap: grep shows core's is the only .gitignore claim across domains. Worktree verified byte-identical at the reviewed SHA after my runs (git status clean, git diff vs 66be65a7 empty). Two cosmetic observations recorded as non-blocking findings.

findings.title: OWNERSHIP comment wording: the FILE was unowned, not the entry
findings.detail: The new core/OWNERSHIP.yaml comment says 'the root .gitignore's single ".mindspec/phase.lock" entry (R3.3) was unowned when bead 1 landed it'. Strictly, ADR-divergence ownership is path-level: the .gitignore FILE was unowned and the claim now covers the whole file, including workflow-motivated entries (the spec-117 dispositions.lock line). The rationale (core machinery motivated the debt-creating entry, and core machinery also backs session.json/current-spec.json/phase.lock) remains sound; this is a wording nit only, no change requested.

findings.title: Domain+rationale noted in commit body, not the Deviations line
findings.detail: The impl prompt asked that the chosen OWNERSHIP domain + rationale be noted 'in Deviations'; the commit says 'Deviations: none' and instead carries the domain and rationale in a dedicated body bullet plus the YAML comment. The information is fully present and auditable; process nit only, no change requested.
